Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a set of acceptance tests focused on the things you called out. Draft attached (Brightline_MAP_v1.xlsx). Key points below so procurement/engineering can skim: 

Summary MAP (two-week evaluation window)
- Day 0 (kickoff): Exchange sample prompt set, provide test harness instructions, share API keys for sandbox (isolated tenant)
- Days 1–4: Integration + smoke tests (connectors, auth, token usage)
- Days 5–9: Load & performance ramp (20rps sustained, bursts to 60rps), collect latency P95/P99, CPU/GPU utilization
- Days 10–12: Concordance & quality run (150 sample prompts, automated scoring + manual spot checks)
- Day 13: Canary cut (routing 10% production traffic to Redwood dedicated pool) + rollback rehearsal
- Day 14: Decision & sign-off meeting

Exit gates / pass criteria (examples)
- Quality: Automated concordance >= 92% against your golden set and no high-severity hallucination on the 10 manual checks
- Latency: P95 <= 180ms, P99 <= 350ms for 512 token average response under the 20rps pattern
- Reliability: Error rate < 1% and no single 5-minute window with >5% errors
- Security: KMS integration validated and audit logging present for all tokens used in the test

Acceptance tests (concrete)
- Functional: 150-item corpus run via test harness; metrics report CSV produced
- Load: k6 script we provide, run defined ramp and steady-state, output latency histograms and resource metrics
- Observability: Token-level cost trace and per-request latency in our console; we’ll share a read-only dashboard link
- Rollback: Simulate a regression by toggling to a fallback model variant; verify rollback completes within configured 60s window

Next actions / asks
- Alice: Share the 150-item prompt set + preferred scoring rubric by Monday EOD
- Procurement: quick review of the sandbox contract and security questionnaire (we’ll fill SOC2 excerpts)
- Lukas/Marissa: we’ll run the load plan and share the acceptance_matrix_v1.csv by Tuesday AM

I attached the draft MAP and marked the sections where we need your inputs. If these gates look good I’ll draft a one-page decision checklist for the sign-off meeting.

Thanks — Lukas
Lukas Meyer
